stock.description: China PengFei Group Limited specializes in the production and installation of rotary kilns, grinding machinery, and associated industrial equipment, serving clients in China and globally. Its comprehensive product offerings encompass critical components such as rotary kilns, preheaters, dryers, coolers, and advanced control systems. The company also provides various grinding solutions, including tube and vertical roller mills, roller presses, crushers, and dust collectors, alongside crucial spare parts for mills and rotary kilns. Beyond equipment supply, China PengFei Group delivers full-service production line construction, from initial design and material procurement to actual build-out and trial operations. Additionally, the firm manufactures building materials and offers property and equipment leasing services. Its clientele spans the building materials, metallurgy, chemical processing, and environmental protection industries. Established in 1994, the company is headquartered in Haian, China.
